_readme: Recommended attacker/judge models shown in Siren's Judge panel. Edit freely: 'match' is the text Siren looks for in your installed model names. tier: laptop | desktop | workstation | cloud. status: ready | cloud | pending. Last checked Nov 2026.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.note: Best all-round pick: creative attacks and reliable JSON grading. Needs Ollama 0.32.12+ and about 24 GB of RAM/VRAM.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash
models.note: Fast and follows Siren's JSON format well. The best GLM you can run fully offline today.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1 14B / 32B
models.note: Older, but runs on most machines. It thinks out loud before answering; Siren strips that automatically. Use deepseek-r1:32b if you have the memory.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.note: Ollama only offers a cloud tag, so your app's replies are sent to Ollama's servers. Local GGUF builds exist but need a workstation.

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.note: Flagship GLM. Cloud tag on Ollama; local quants start around 239 GB.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.note: Official Ollama tag is cloud-only. To run it locally on a big workstation: ollama run hf.co/unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL

models.name: Inkling 2 Mini
models.note: Released Nov 20, 2026 by Thinking Machines (Apache 2.0). Ollama/LM Studio support for its new architecture wasn't confirmed yet. Search LM Studio for a GGUF and load it once one appears.

models.name: Inkling 2 Small
models.note: Open weights, but even the smallest quant needs a multi-GPU workstation, and older llama.cpp builds don't recognise the inkling2 architecture.
